description: Start a job that turns one 360 photo into a metric depth shell you can stand inside: a textured GLB mesh in metres with the camera at the origin, plus a PLY point cloud. Input is a public https image_url and source_kind: equirect_image (a stitched 2:1 equirectangular jpg, png or exr) or insp (a raw 360 photo, which is stitched first). Returns a job_id at once; a photo typically takes one to five minutes (longer for a raw .insp or a cold GPU). Collect it with pano_scene_status. The result is owned files (GLB and PLY) and a viewer link. Use this when the user has a single 360 photo and wants a 3D place from it. Needs a free three.ws account.

image_url.description: Public https URL of the 360 photo.

source_kind.description: equirect_image for a stitched 2:1 photo, insp for a raw .insp file.

name: pano_scene_create
title: Turn a 360 photo into a depth shell
